hooks.name: vidux-pre-commit
hooks.description: When manually installed as .git/hooks/pre-commit, blocks staged non-Markdown changes if a root PLAN.md exists without a pending or in-progress task.

hooks.name: vidux-post-commit-reminder
hooks.description: When manually installed as .git/hooks/post-commit, reminds when the root PLAN.md has no progress entry for the current day. It does not mutate the plan.

hooks.name: vidux-three-strike
hooks.description: Warns when at least three of the last ten commit subjects contain fix, retry, or attempt.
